newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-HIGH WINDS DELAY COMBINED DOWNHILL.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-HIGH WINDS DELAY COMBINED DOWNHILL.

text.p: High winds delayed the women's combined downhill at the world ski championships by one hour on Thursday.

The 1100 GMT race had already been moved down the mountain to the super-G starting point. But officials said even that was not possible as the wind buffeted safety netting and sent snow billowing across the piste.
Only 26 starters had entered the event, by far the lowest number of the championships.
